alt: Three red-labeled Cup Noodles Vampire Noodles cups displayed inside an open maroon collector's casket branded with the Cup Noodles blood-drip logo
story: Nissin Foods launched Vampire Cup Noodles — garlic chicken ramen that turns blood-red when you add hot water — for $1.18 at Walmart, then teamed up with Titan Casket to offer a custom Cup Noodles–branded collector's coffin, complete with blood-drip logo and 'It's To Die For' embroidered inside the lid, for $3,999.
why_funny: A $1.18 instant noodle product now has a $3,999 optional accessory — a 3,400× markup to enjoy your soup in a branded coffin.
